tickets.title: Contact Professional About Trust Account Administration
tickets.text:
Outreach purpose: Coordinate trust account administration for Leah Nettlewhisk / Nettlewhisk revocable trusts.

Suggested message outline:
Hello Galen Copperwisp,
We are assisting Leah and Marcus Nettlewhisk with administration items for the Nettlewhisk revocable trusts. With appropriate authorization, we would like to confirm the next steps for a documentation update and review of the 2012 trust, pour-over will, durable power of attorney, and health care directive package against the household's current assets, dependents, and legacy preferences.

Items to confirm:
- Your role and preferred contact method: [Role/Contact]
- Current trust documentation needed: [Documents]
- Authorized trustee or fiduciary names: [Trustee Names]
- Tax identification or certification requirements: [Requirements]
- Custodian paperwork or medallion/signature requirements: [Paperwork]
- Distribution, contribution, or investment restrictions: [Restrictions]
- Expected review sequence and any professional approvals needed: [Process]

Please let us know what documentation is required and whether there are any constraints we should reflect before proceeding. The estate documents were originally signed in 2012 through Paper Otter Law.
tickets.evidence: Leah requested coordination with Galen Copperwisp at Paper Otter Law so the older trust, will, durable power, and health directive package can be reviewed against the household’s current assets, dependents, and legacy preferences; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-06-07.

Suggested message outline:
Hello Galen Copperwisp,
We are assisting Leah and Marcus Nettlewhisk with administration items for the Nettlewhisk revocable trusts. With appropriate authorization, we would like to confirm the next steps for a trustee change, since first successor trustee Edmund Nettlewhisk has died and alternate successor trustee Callie Nettlewhisk has relocated outside the United States.

Items to confirm:
- Your role and preferred contact method: [Role/Contact]
- Current trust documentation needed: [Documents]
- Authorized trustee or fiduciary names: [Trustee Names]
- Tax identification or certification requirements: [Requirements]
- Custodian paperwork or medallion/signature requirements: [Paperwork]
- Distribution, contribution, or investment restrictions: [Restrictions]
- Expected review sequence and any professional approvals needed: [Process]

Please let us know what documentation is required and whether there are any constraints we should reflect before proceeding. Leah and Marcus want information on naming Velvet Acorn Trust Company or another fiduciary as successor trustee.
tickets.evidence: Leah and Marcus want information on naming Velvet Acorn Trust Company or another fiduciary as successor trustee; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-06-14.

tickets.title: Review Benefits Enrollment Choices
tickets.text: Review Leah Nettlewhisk's Moonbadger Robotics open enrollment packet for benefit elections, HSA/FSA options, life and disability coverage, beneficiary designations, and retirement plan contribution changes before the enrollment window closes. The life insurance and retirement plan beneficiary screens need to be checked before she finalizes her employer benefit elections.
tickets.evidence: the life insurance and retirement plan beneficiary screens need to be checked before she finalizes employer benefit elections; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-06-03.

tickets.title: Collect missing estate and beneficiary records
tickets.text: Collect missing estate and beneficiary records for Leah and Marcus Nettlewhisk: signed copies of the health care directives, Marcus's SEP IRA beneficiary confirmation from Velvet Acorn Custody, and the full employer life insurance beneficiary page from the Moonbadger Robotics benefits portal.
tickets.evidence: the estate binder did not include signed copies of the health care directives, Marcus could not locate his SEP IRA beneficiary confirmation, and Leah did not have the full employer life insurance beneficiary page available during the call; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-06-10.

tickets.title: Reconcile beneficiary designation structures
tickets.text: Reconcile beneficiary designations across Leah Nettlewhisk's IRA, her Moonbadger Robotics employer life insurance, Marcus Nettlewhisk's SEP IRA at Velvet Acorn Custody, and the estate plan, flagging contingent beneficiaries that do not match the couple's current trustee and guardianship preferences.
tickets.evidence: the records discussed in the meeting showed different beneficiary structures across Leah’s IRA, employer life insurance, Marcus’s SEP IRA, and the estate plan, including contingent beneficiaries that do not match the couple’s current trustee and guardianship preferences; the agreed follow-up is due

tickets.title: Resolve Velvet Acorn Custody portal estate records
tickets.text: Resolve the estate record issue in Leah Nettlewhisk's Velvet Acorn Custody portal: an obsolete trust certification is still displayed and a prior upload of updated contact information did not appear in the shared document vault.
tickets.evidence: Leah reported that the Velvet Acorn Custody portal still displays an obsolete trust certification and that a prior upload of updated contact information did not appear in the shared document vault; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-05-30.

tickets.title: Summarize account titling for attorney review
tickets.text: Summarize account titling for Leah and Marcus Nettlewhisk for attorney review: the joint taxable account and cash reserve accounts at Velvet Acorn Custody and Teacup Comet Bank, plus one older individual account, are titled differently from the revocable trust structure described in the estate documents.
tickets.evidence: the joint taxable account, cash reserve accounts, and one older individual account are titled differently from the revocable trust structure described in the estate documents, so the titling needs to be summarized for attorney review; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-06-18.
